author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.8.4. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched. RESCAN REQUIRED - the graph data model changed.

DISCOVERY: app enumeration now unions /hub2/appsList with the existing device-led scan, so an app that touches no device (a Rule Function, a schedule-only app, a container) is no longer invisible.

Such apps are drawn instead of dropped, dimmed, and labelled with why they're empty - holds N apps, owns N devices, runs on a schedule, listens to N events, child of X, or references nothing. They sit on a fixed shelf below the main graph so they don't get pulled into the cluster by the layout physics, and can be clicked through to like any other app.

RULE LINKS: recognises two more Rule Machine storage forms seen in community testing - ruleActMain (an alternate Run Actions target) and privateF (an alternate Private Boolean target).

RENAMED for accuracy: 'Stops' is now 'Cancel timed actions'. Pause/Resume now shows which one occurred where the hub records it, rather than always showing both as possible.

INSIGHTS: a new 'Broken rule references' section lists any target that no longer resolves to anything, and which apps still reference it.

FIXED: long device/app labels no longer overwrite each other in the focused view. Added back navigation inside the map and Insights panels.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
